abstract: The document is a review article titled "Plant-derived immunomodulators: an insight on their preclinical evaluation and clinical trials" published in 2015 in Frontiers in Plant Science. The abstract discusses the limitations of current immunomodulatory drugs, which are often cytotoxic and have side effects. It highlights the growing interest in herbal medicines as multi-component agents for modulating the immune system, with phytochemicals like flavonoids, polysaccharides, lactones, alkaloids, diterpenoids, and glycosides being responsible for these properties. The review aims to provide an overview of widely investigated plant-derived compounds, including curcumin, resveratrol, epigallocatechol-3-gallate, quercetin, colchicine, capsaicin, andrographolide, and genistein, focusing on their preclinical evidence and clinical potential. The document also includes a comprehensive list of 189 references.
